about_the_game:
In a land plagued by monsters, undead, and the occasional truffle bandit, four unlikely heroes join forces to take on the impossible. With the help of a talkative bird, a roaring arena crowd, and a suspiciously lazy adventurer’s guild, you’ll fight, explore, and scheme your way to glory.

Arena of Suffering is an old-school JRPG with modern polish. Explore bustling towns, ten dangerous dungeons, and a country full of trouble, all while battling over 120 unique monsters. Build your dream team from nine distinct classes and find devastating party combinations to absolutely flatten your opponents.

Features

  • Old-School Combat, Modern Shine – Front-view battles keep every fight tense, with detailed enemy art and strategic depth.

  • Party Creation Freedom – Nine unique classes to mix and match for any style: pure damage, brute force, magic dominance, or tricky crowd control.

  • Bosses… and Their Bosses – Each dungeon has a story boss, two Elites with their own tactics, and a brutal Hidden Boss for those who crave punishment.

  • Epic Soundtrack – Over 50 original tracks, with unique themes for each boss and nine rotating battle tracks to keep combat fresh.

  • More Than Fighting – Explore towns, uncover hidden areas, tackle 40+ side quests, and meet a cast of colorful NPCs.

So enter the arena, prove your worth, and get rich in the process. The adventurer's guild is always looking for the right types of heroes, and you know you've got what is takes. Join today!

short_description: A classic RPG of strategic turn-based combat, dangerous dungeon crawls, and total party customization. Build the best heroes in the land — and by the end, you won’t just face the final boss. You’ll be the final boss.
